text_block_list.text:
—Finally, the debut race draws near.
Today, she's doing tandem training with another
Umamusume debuting around the same time.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Taaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh— S-So fast!
Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer, how was that~?
choice_data_list: Thank goodness! Do you still have some energy left?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes, quite. About 0.18 miles.
When she outdueled the other at the end, it didn't look like she went all out... Guess my hunch was right.
choice_data_list: Let's do one more after the break.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
In that case, would it be okay if I started from behind?
Sort of like I'm chasing after her.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, that run just now... didn't feel right.
I've just got this lingering, murky feeling."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm sorry, I can't explain it well!
But something just feels off, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: So just this once, please let me run freely according to my own instincts!

I couldn't identify what felt off
based on what Gran Alegria said alone.
However, seeing her run might give me the answer!
And then, for one more run—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yeah, feeling good! All right, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Miler!

Making her move at the corner, Gran Alegria overtook the competition in a flash without even giving them a chance to contest.
Widening the gap further and further, she pulled clean away!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that felt awesome!
A full 100 miles of pure exhilaration!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I've got a complete grasp on the optimal feel!
choice_data_list: Pacing yourself in the first half felt off, didn't it?
Pacing yourself in the first half felt off, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, it's not.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hmm, that's not what I mean.
choice_data_list: My stride length during the spurt...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No, it's more of an intuitive thing!
Like the way it fits, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: So, I feel like words just can't describe it.
No, I had no idea at all.
I had no idea what was feeling off to Gran Alegria...

After training, I went to a bookstore
and bought every reference book that looked helpful.
She is likely an intuitive genius.
I've heard stories about several athletes who were that type of genius.
From books about them and interview videos, I search for commonalities with Gran Alegria.
If we're talking about perception, psychology might be involved too...!

And having armed myself with knowledge,
I headed into the next day's training, but—
choice_data_list: That one just now was a nice 80 miles, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: No, 50 miles didn't feel quite right.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If 80 mph felt that good,
I bet my footwork can be even lighter and sharper!
—I didn't stand a chance at all.
choice_data_list: Going purely by intuition is way too hard...!

text_block_list.text:
"It's entirely based on individual intuition,
so manuals of any kind are completely useless."

Therefore, there was no other way
than repeated trial and error...

And so, with the issue still unresolved...
the time for her Make Debut arrived.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
is it okay if I turn up the radio volume?
choice_data_list: Still, it'd bother the people around us, so...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Alright then,
I'll move it closer.
Listening to the radio, Gran Alegria seemed exceptionally relaxed.
choice_data_list: (Could it be... the effect of my rule?)

text_block_list.text: I thought "My Rules" were just quirks of hers, but—

It might be part of her pre-race routine.
Like a way to keep her "sensory feel" at its absolute best.
choice_data_list: (Just knowing that is a big gain...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my. Over there...
That's Taiki-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"To think you caught the eye of Taiki-san,
the one called the strongest miler. That's amazing, Gran-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Taiki-san!
Are you here to cheer for Gran-chan?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! I was very, very
excited for your debut, Gran!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... I-I heard you raced against Gran-chan
in the past. Is that connection the reason...?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fate plays a part, but above all,
I'm interested—it piques my interest!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I felt true potential
in Gran's running.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So, I want to witness it! The scenery that Gran reaches!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪
Almost there, almost there.
choice_data_list: Gran? Is something wrong with your leg?
Gran? Is something wrong with your leg?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: No? Oh, could you be skipping?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Skip when you're itching to run!"
That's my personal pre-race rule!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: If anything, I'm feeling great, so don't worry!
choice_data_list: I see... In that case, I'll be looking forward to it!
I see... Then I'll be counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Trainer, please don't forget either, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Our personal rule together!
